Expanding the chain and selecting the earlier round opened version 1. On C-524's Documents tab, "Show the 1 earlier version of repo-search-legal-09251315.pdf" expanded the chain and selecting the earlier round opened "repo-search-legal-092… (7) As Legal Team Member outside its team, Record choices for C-521 read "Record No matching choices Choose one value Apply", Counterparty choices for "DOC-030 Hidden Counterparty 09251315" read "Counterparty No matching choices Matches any selected value Apply", the repository read did not include its Document, the direct Documents read answered 404, and the address showed "C-521 does not exist, or you cannot open it. (10) Dragging the "repo-drag-legal-09251315.txt" row revealed the Move to folder panel with "DOC-030 Legal Repo folder" as a target; dropping on "DOC-030 Legal Repo folder" filed the Document there (read-back). Confirmed the author's limitation: DOC-009 does not state the latest-Version rule. On the lab, header Search found a Document by a word only in its latest Version and did not find it by a word only in its earlier Version.
